jo: quick FYI from staging bringup: reranker-omega shows NDCG@10 +1.4% but MRR@10 -3.2%. punctuation-heavy queries (questions, parentheses) are the worst hit.
kevin: did you change tokenizer or any normalization?
jo: i swapped the preproc pipeline to use the new norm-step that normalizes punctuation clusters (e.g., '?!' -> '?'). config: `punct_cluster_normalize=true` and tokenizer is `bpe_v3` in staging vs `spm_v2` in offline eval.
mina: that feels like a token-boundary shift. quantized models squeeze score margins so tiny ordering deltas show up as top-1 flips. did you run fp32 vs int8 parity?
jo: ran short parity with the same candidate set:
```
./eval_rerank --gold holdout_v5.json --pred preds_omega_int8.json --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --slices punct_queries,plain_queries --preproc-config preproc_punct.yaml
```
results:
- fp32 (punct norm off, spm_v2): ndcg +0.6, mrr -0.4
- int8 (punct norm on, bpe_v3): ndcg +1.4, mrr -3.2
- int8 (punct norm off, spm_v2): ndcg +0.7, mrr -0.6
so toggling the punct normalization explains most of the delta.
kevin: can you paste an example qid?
jo: example qid=Q-742. query: "How to reset password?!"
- offline prompt tokenized -> tokens [..., 112, 89]
- punct-normalized prompt -> "How to reset password?" -> tokens [..., 112, 72]
fp32 scores: D4=0.821, D1=0.819 (gap 0.002) -> int8 compresses to 0.0001 -> tie-break picks D1 which isn't gold -> MRR loss.
mina: OK sounds like an interaction: punctuation normalization + tokenizer change + quant compression. mitigation suggestions: 1) add `preproc_checksum` + `tokenizer_id` parity check in onboarding artifact, 2) CI smoke that runs a small punct-slice (~200 qids) comparing int8 vs fp32 MRR with a loose threshold (fail if drop >2%), 3) document in model card that "punctuation normalization can amplify quantized scoring ties", 4) consider deterministic tie-break (doc_id hash bias) in serving.
jo: i prototyped a tiny tie-break: `score += (int(doc_id[-6:],16) % 1000) * 1e-7` pre-softmax. stabilizes many cases in int8 without changing fp32 ordering. i'll add it as an opt-in flag in the serving binary.
kevin: please also add a unit test in eval-harness that tokenizes a 500-sample of punct-heavy queries under both preproc variants and reports fraction with token-id diffs > 5. would catch this early.
mina: +1. also add a step to the deployment preflight to compare `punct_cluster_normalize` flag in staging to the offline eval artifact and fail if mismatch.
jo: opening PRs: (A) onboarding schema update to include `tokenizer_id` and `preproc_flags` (B) CI smoke job for punct-slice int8 parity (C) tie-breaker opt-in in serving (D) unit test for token-diff stats. uploading artifacts and failing qids to s3://redwood-eval/artifacts/rerank/omega/1713334444/
ci-bot: staging snapshot created: snapshot-rerank-omega-2026-04-10T10:15:00Z :rocket:
kevin: nice catch. one follow-up: if we widely enable punct normalization, we should re-run offline gold generation with that preproc so the golden matches production.
mina: agree. for now require parity check gating and CI smoke. thanks for the quick root-cause. :mag:
jo: will add model card note: "Observed: punctuation-cluster normalization interacts with quantized scoring leading to top-1 instability on punctuation-heavy queries." PRs coming. resolving until PRs land.
